apps.name: TwitchAdBlock (no plugins)
apps.subtitle: Variant: no plugins
apps.localizedDescription:
## What's New

**Hide community highlights.** New master toggle in Settings → Declutter that lets you hide distracting overlays above chat — pinned messages, hype trains, predictions, polls, sub goals, and Twitch Drops notifications. Each one has its own sub-toggle so you can pick exactly what to hide.

**Skip proxy for specific channels.** Some channels don't run ads at all. You can now list channels that should skip the ad-block proxy entirely in Settings → Proxy → Skip Proxy for Channels. Subscribed channels already skip it automatically.

**Hide clip button.** New toggle to remove the clip button from the video player controls.

**Fixed 7TV emotes from other channels showing in chat.** Emotes from a channel you previously visited no longer leak into other channels' chats.

**Fixed a video playback error with proxied streams.** Some streams could show "an error has occurred trying to play this content" when using the proxy. Fixed.

**Fixed Home launch screen on Twitch 31.9.** The "Home → Following", "Home → Live", and "Home → Clips" options now work again on the latest Twitch version.

**Fixed settings import.** Importing an old settings file no longer causes playback errors — stale settings are properly cleared first.

|------|-------------|
| `tv.twitch-31.9-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.21.ipa` | Sideload IPA (AltStore / SideStore / TrollStore) |
| `tv.twitch-31.9-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.21-no-plugins.ipa` | Sideload IPA without app extensions (fewer app ID slots) |
| `com.level3tjg.twitchadblock_0.1.21_iphoneos-arm.deb` | Jailbreak .deb (rootful) |
| `com.level3tjg.twitchadblock_0.1.21_iphoneos-arm64.deb` | Jailbreak .deb (rootless) |
